The Cost
The Cost of Building It Yourself

This is what you're building
instead of your business.

Building it yourself
✗
Integrate every provider separately
Each bank (KTB, SCB, GSB), wallet (TrueMoney), and crypto network has its own API, authentication scheme, and response format — each must be integrated one by one.
✗
Build all infrastructure from scratch
Webhook handler, transaction database, reconciliation engine, monitoring, and security must all be designed, built, and maintained entirely by your team.
✗
Rebuild every time you add a method
Want to add PromptPay later? That's weeks of additional integration work — and your system needs regression testing each time.
6–12 months of development. Your team maintains it forever.
With please payment
✓
One API for all payment methods
A single REST API connects you to PromptPay, Bank Transfer, Wallet, Payment Link, and Crypto. No need to deal with individual providers.
✓
Infrastructure already built for you
Webhook delivery, transaction tracking, reconciliation, and monitoring are all included. Your team focuses on your product — not payment plumbing.
✓
Add methods without code changes
When a new payment method is supported, you get it automatically. No additional development, no regression testing, no re-integration.
Ship in days. Scale without rebuilding.

Capabilities
What Can Please Payment Do?

Everything you need to accept money.

💳
Accept Payments
Your customers can pay using PromptPay QR, Bank Transfer, TrueMoney Wallet, Payment Link, Dynamic QR, or Crypto — all through one unified experience. You don't need to build or maintain each payment method separately.
🔄
Manage Transactions
Every payment is tracked in real time — from pending to confirmed to settled. You can view history, process refunds, handle expired payments, and retry failed deliveries, all from one dashboard or via API.
🔌
Connect Your System
A clean REST API and webhook system lets your backend know the moment a payment succeeds. Built-in idempotency, signature verification, and automatic retries mean no missed events and no double charges.
📊
Operate Your Business
The merchant dashboard gives your team full visibility — transaction reports, daily reconciliation, settlement tracking, audit trail, and monitoring alerts — so operations run smoothly without custom tooling.

Why Please Payment
Why Please Payment?

Own your payment stack.
Keep control of your money.

The traditional way
✗
Funds go through intermediaries
Most payment processors hold your money before releasing it. Settlement takes days, and you have no direct control over when or how your funds move.
✗
Corporate bank account required
Traditional payment gateways require a registered company with a corporate bank account — blocking individuals, freelancers, and small operators from getting started.
✗
Ongoing maintenance is your problem
Security patches, uptime monitoring, backups, and compliance all remain your team's responsibility — indefinitely, even when your payment volume stays the same.
With please payment
✓
Money goes directly to your account
Non-custodial by design. Every payment lands directly in your bank account the moment it clears — no intermediary holds your funds, no waiting for settlement.
✓
Personal bank account is welcome
No corporate registration required. Any individual, freelancer, or small business can set up their own payment gateway and start accepting money today.
✓
Self-hosted on modest hardware
Runs on a low-spec server or even a personal computer. No expensive cloud infrastructure, no dedicated DevOps team — just deploy and start accepting payments.
Your gateway. Your account. Your rules.

Administrator
Administrator

Full control over your team,
your access, and your audit trail.

👥
Users & Access
Invite team members and assign them to your organization. Each user gets their own login — no shared passwords. Access is scoped to the permissions you grant.
🛡
Custom Roles
Define exactly what each role can see and do — view-only for finance, full access for ops, restricted to a single merchant for agents. Granular permission control built in.
🔑
API Keys
Generate and rotate API keys per merchant. Each key is scoped to one integration, so a compromised key doesn't expose your entire gateway — just rotate and continue.
📋
Audit Log
Every action logged — who changed what setting, from which IP, at what time. Full traceability for compliance, incident response, and accountability across all merchant accounts.
